scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: bash -c 'cd server && npm run dev & server_pid=$!; cd ../client && npm run dev & client_pid=$!; trap "kill $server_pid $client_pid 2>/dev/null || true" INT TERM EXIT; wait $server_pid $client_pid'
